CVE-2025-4207.title: Buffer over-read in PostgreSQL GB18030 encoding validation allows ...
CVE-2025-4207.description: Buffer over-read in PostgreSQL GB18030 encoding validation allows a database input provider to achieve temporary denial of service on platforms where a 1-byte over-read can elicit process termination.  This affects the database server and also libpq.  Versions before PostgreSQL 17.5, 16.9, 15.13, 14.18, and 13.21 are affected.

CVE-2026-116328.title: Integer wraparound in PostgreSQL generation memory contexts allow ...
CVE-2026-116328.description: Integer wraparound in PostgreSQL generation memory contexts allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via freeing an allocation larger than 1 GB and causing its block to be reused for smaller chunks whose back-pointer offset cannot represent that position.  Within major versions 16-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16 are affected.  Versions before PostgreSQL 16 are unaffected.
